push.title: W 3-0 vs Jebem Ti Kruha | You: 7.4 (above average FOR)
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 7.4 against Jebem Ti Kruha. A good honest shift, like a well-made chair.

DID WELL
+ 3 shots at Jebem Ti Kruha's goal. You kept testing them until something cracked.
+ 3 of 3 shots on target. That's composure in front of goal.
+ 1 key pass. That's the kind of creativity that keeps opposing coaches up at night.
+ A goal against Jebem Ti Kruha. You didn't hesitate, and the keeper didn't stand a chance.
+ Man of the Match, your 6th for us. That's a performance people follow.

WORK ON
- 67% passing (2 of 3, down from your usual 75%). Before the killer ball, check: is my runner onside, moving, and unmarked? Two out of three isn't enough.
- 0.5 below your average. Even the sun takes a cloudy day off.
- Goals per shot on target: 33%. Solid, but the best forwards hit 60%+.

Five-minute drill: If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.

Small fixes, big changes. - Coach Lasso

push.body:

+ 3-0 over Jebem Ti Kruha. Make it a habit.

- No tackles attempted (down from your usual 4). Here's the fix: When we lose it, press for 3-5 seconds right away. That's when they're most disorganized.
- Rating came in 4.2 below what your on-ball stats earned. Your rating came in lower than your stats say, and that gap is off-ball: positioning, interceptions, blocks.
- Both you and BellyTb1 dipped on on-ball involvement. Lean on each other: make triangles, 1-2 touch.

We'll fix it together. - Coach Lasso
